pages.title: Welcome
pages.subtitle: One system for the whole of it

blocks.heading: Why a single planner
paragraphs: Most people run their life across four systems that do not speak to each other: a work calendar, a fitness app, a banking app, and good intentions. The gaps between them are where things get dropped, and the dropped things are almost always the personal ones.

blocks.heading: What is inside
items: A wheel of life assessment, scored, so you can see which areas are actually thin
Annual down to daily planning, in the same book as everything else
Health, sleep, food and movement tracked without a separate app
Money — an overview, a budget and savings goals
People, learning, travel and the things you keep meaning to do

blocks.heading: You will not use all of it
paragraphs: That is the design. Print or fill the sections that match the year you are having. A planner that demands completion gets abandoned in February; one you can use partially gets used in November.

blocks.heading: Start with the wheel
paragraphs: Score the areas before you set a single goal. Effort spent on an area already scoring eight returns very little. The same effort on an area scoring three changes the year.

pages.title: Instructions
pages.subtitle: An evening to set up, ten minutes a week to keep

blocks.heading: Choose your size
paragraphs: Four sizes are included and all four contain identical pages. A4 and US Letter suit the desk. A5 and Half Letter suit a bag or a tablet, and print two-up on a full sheet.

blocks.heading: Set up once
items: Score the Wheel of Life honestly and quickly
Write the life vision and the mission statement
Name your core values — five at most, or they are not values
Set annual goals only in the areas the wheel says are thin
Fill the morning and evening routine pages

blocks.heading: Keep it running
items: Daily planner and habit tracker — two minutes
Monthly planner and monthly review at the turn of the month
Annual review once, properly, in December

blocks.heading: Digital use
items: Import the PDF as a document, not as an image
Switch to read mode to tap links, write mode to write
Use the tabs to move between life areas from any page
